title: Tokenization Disparities as Infrastructure Bias: How Subword Systems Create Inequities in LLM Access and Efficiency

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating tokenization efficiency across over 200 languages using the FLORES-200 parallel text dataset and the tiktoken (cl100k) BPE tokenizer. The evaluation calculates and compares metrics such as Tokens Per Sentence (TPS), Characters Per Token (CPT), and Relative Tokenization Cost (RTC) benchmarked against an English baseline to quantify algorithmic and infrastructural disparities among high-resource, low-resource, Latin-script, and non-Latin script languages.
